newsitem.title: FRANCE: French state bank union rally Tuesday over Foncier.
newsitem.headline: French state bank union rally Tuesday over Foncier.

text.p: Trade unions across France's state banking sector said on Thursday they would stage a protest rally on Tuesday in solidarity with the besieged Credit Foncier bank in Paris and against job cuts in the banking industry.

The rally is set for 1100 GMT on Tuesday in front of Credit Foncier's Paris headquarters, which have been occupied since Friday by staff fighting plans to break up their bank, unions from 14 state bank and finance groups said in a statement.
The decision was taken after a meeting within the Credit Foncier building in downtown Paris.

"Above and beyond the repeated and indescribable attacks on Credit Foncier, a series of destructive plans is being drawn up for our establishments... concrete alternatives can be found," said the statement.
The unions said they represented 80,000 employees from state and semi-state groups including the independent central bank and state-owned bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations.
The unions said they had been backing Credit Foncier through its turmoil for more than a year with calls for a moratorium on job cuts and a debate in parliament on the future of the sector.
